audio.evidence_note: Local faster-whisper small with VAD returned no speech segments. Half-second left/right RMS differs by no more than 0.4 dB, so the signal provides little evidence of a strong camera-following lateral sweep; this is not a substitute for a perceptual sound-mix review.

scene_review: High-frequency contact sheets around every threshold hit show continuous body and camera movement, occlusion, and exposure change rather than a clear hard cut or crossfade.
evidence_boundary: Findings come from one-second and four-frames-per-second contact sheets plus 12-frames-per-second review around automated scene hits. One returned sample cannot establish repeatability.
